# => configuration file non existing, creating it
exec govulnfilter init
stdout 'Created configuration file .+\.govulnfilter\.json'
! stderr .
cmp .govulnfilter.json want.json

# => configuration file already existing
mv foo.json .govulnfilter.json
! exec govulnfilter init
! stdout .
stderr 'init: configuration file already exists: .+\.govulnfilter\.json'

-- foo.json --
{}
-- want.json --
{
    "description": "Configuration file for govulnfilter",
    "schema_version": "devel",
    "project": "Replace with your project name",
    "delays": [
        {
            "osv": "GO-2026-4736",
            "summary": "Optional, should come from govulncheck output",
            "expiration": "2026-11-20T00:00:00+01:00",
            "reason": "Reason for delaying this vulnerability"
        }
    ]
}
